command:
set -euo pipefail; BASE=/workspace/frankgrid10-organ; PID=$(cat "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid"); kill -0 "$PID"; CMD=$(tr '\0' ' ' <"/proc/$PID/cmdline"); printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -Fq '/workspace/frankgrid10-organ/code/organ_daemon.py'; python3 - "$BASE/run/heartbeat.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys,time,subprocess
p=sys.argv[1]
a=json.load(open(p)); print('HB1',json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True)); time.sleep(3); b=json.load(open(p)); print('HB2',json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True)); assert b['pid']==a['pid']; assert b['seq']>a['seq']; assert b['wall_time']>a['wall_time']; assert b['status']=='RUNNING'; print('HEARTBEAT_ADVANCED',b['seq']-a['seq'])
PY
echo PID=$PID; echo CMDLINE=$CMD; echo FRANKGRID10_ORGAN_PERSISTENCE_PASS
